   145	async def get_task_count(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
   146	    async with check_params(request, TaskTypeParams) as params:
   147	        ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
   148	        if params.task_type == TaskTypes.RUNNING:
   149	            count = len(asyncio.all_tasks(ctx.monitor._monitored_loop))
   150	        elif params.task_type == TaskTypes.TERMINATED:
   151	            count = len(ctx.monitor._terminated_history)
   152	        else:
   153	            raise RuntimeError("should not reach here")
   154	        return web.json_response(
   155	            data={
   156	                "value": count,

   209	async def cancel_task(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
   210	    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
   211	    async with check_params(request, TaskIdParams) as params:

   217	                    "detail": coro_repr,
   218	                },
   219	            )
   220	        except ValueError as e:
